decisions.decision: Bookkeeping commit 1bd5bf6 was created BEFORE phase execution to land the milestone v1.1 -> v1.2 transition that was sitting uncommitted in the working tree (PROJECT.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, config.json updates; archived phase directory deletions; restored MILESTONES.md from HEAD which had been accidentally wiped; tracked .planning/codebase/ + 06-CONTEXT.md + 06-DISCUSSION-LOG.md)
decisions.rationale: Without this, executor-agent worktrees would have inherited a clean HEAD without these inputs, and worktree merges would have committed the unattributed MILESTONES.md wipe and other pending changes as if they were Phase 6 outputs.

decisions.decision: Plan 06-02 hit a usage limit AFTER writing 06-02-SUMMARY.md but BEFORE committing it. Orchestrator applied rescue protocol (commit 12ce24c) - committed the SUMMARY from inside the worktree on the agent's behalf, then merged normally.
decisions.rationale: The implementation commit 7e1d684 (manual.html 304 -> 731 lines) was already on the worktree branch and SUMMARY.md was complete with Self-Check: PASSED. Rescue avoids losing valid work to the worktree-removal step.

decisions.decision: User reference image for layout came mid-Wave 3 verification cycle. Verifier returned human_needed (9/10) because visual/UX correctness can't be programmatically verified; user immediately responded with the corrected APC40 reference image. This was treated as gap-closure feedback.
decisions.rationale: The original Plan 06-02 build had the layout essentially inverted (clip grid in middle, encoders as 1x8 strips on the left, missing TRACK SELECTION row, missing Pan/Send physical buttons, missing cursor pad, missing Detail row, missing Cue Level knob, crossfader at wrong position). User chose 'direct rewrite, single commit' over /gsd-plan-phase 6 --gaps for speed.

decisions.decision: Layout overhaul (commit e5f067e) added 6 new element classes: .pan-send-btn, .cursor-pad, .track-select-pad, .detail-row-btn, .cue-level-knob, .device-encoder-ring. All original data-* attributes preserved verbatim so mode-strip JS contract is honored.
decisions.rationale: The mode-strip JS at line 1055 (setEncoderMode) and 1367 (setMatrixMode) queries .top-encoder, .device-encoder, .grid-pad, .track-stop, .scene-launch, .solo-pad, .mute-pad, .arm-pad, etc. Renaming any of those would break repaint. Adding new classes is additive and safe.

decisions.decision: Device-encoder rings use new .device-encoder-ring class (NOT .top-encoder-ring) with their own tooltip block.
decisions.rationale: JS at line 776 queries .top-encoder-ring and applies top-encoder-mode tooltips. If device rings used the same class, they would get wrong-row tooltips. New class + parallel tooltip wiring (with '(lower row)' tag) keeps content correct.

decisions.decision: README.md.bak (untracked) preserves pre-v1.2 README content from before plan 06-08 wrote the thin pointer.
decisions.rationale: Plan 06-08's worktree merge initially failed because untracked README.md was blocking the merge from creating its own README.md. Rename to .bak preserved a backup for diff/comparison rather than deleting.
